description: The donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” visually represents the distribution of 38 total stimuli used in a study on generative AI’s use in journalism, categorized by source or format. The largest segment, colored dark green, corresponds to “External News Article,” accounting for 15 out of 38 stimuli (approximately 39.5%). The second-largest segment, in deep red, represents “Draft/Other,” with 9 out of 38 (about 23.7%). Following this, “Email” is shown in maroon and comprises 5 out of 38 (roughly 13.2%). “Interview,” in purple, accounts for 2 out of 38 (about 5.3%). “Press Release,” in golden yellow, makes up 4 out of 38 (approximately 10.5%). The smallest segment, in orange, is “Intra-agency news article,” with just 1 out of 38 (around 2.6%). Each segment is labeled with its category name and exact count over total (e.g., “15/38”), and the segments appear arranged roughly in descending order clockwise from the top-left. A grayed-out label at the bottom right is partially obscured and not legible. The chart uses distinct colors for each category and centers the title “Stimuli Type” in bold black text within the donut hole.
